instrument.title: Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting

austrian_notification_layers.source: Austrian reservations and notifications at ratification

other_mli_articles.note: Retain outside the TaxTreat WHT rate engine only where another product or legal analysis needs them.

bilateral_adjudication_method: identify whether the treaty is potentially covered by Austria's current CTA notification
verify the partner jurisdiction's CTA notification
determine Article 35 effective date specifically for withholding taxes
cross-check against the current Austrian synthesized treaty text where available
record PPT as a WHT overlay only when bilaterally effective
release_constraints: Austria-side CTA notification is not sufficient evidence of bilateral MLI effect.
No PPT effect may be promoted without bilateral matching.
No withholding-tax PPT effect may be promoted without pair-specific Article 35 effective-date analysis.
Austria reserved MLI Article 8 in full; the onboarding engine must not create an MLI 365-day dividend holding-period condition.
A synthesized treaty text is strong pair-level implementation evidence where available but does not replace preservation of the underlying instrument chain.
